info.title: T3rnel Browser Session Bridge (local)
info.description: The local bridge an agent runs (`npx -y @t3ratech/mcp-session-bridge`) to reach the user's real browser through the extension. It listens on 127.0.0.1 in the SESSION_BRIDGE_PORT range (17311-17318): /health answers liveness, /ws is the WebSocket control channel the extension attaches to. No remote API exists — the operator's browser is the server.

servers.description: First port the bridge tries; scans the range until one binds

get.summary: Liveness — the extension uses it for the pairing card
WebSocket upgrade — the extension attaches here; agent traffic is MCP-over-stdio upstream

pairing.name: x-t3rnel-bridge-token
pairing.description: Pairing token minted when the extension approves the bridge — auto-approved by default, prompt-gated when the operator arms the gate
